items.text: Merrill recruits experienced advisors, though CFO Alastair Borthwick notes this is not an enormous part of its strategy, with a training program for people in wealth management as the larger focus.
items.quote: we're picking up the recruiting of experienced advisors. That isn't an enormous part of our strategy, but it's a training program so that we're training people in wealth management, Bank of America, and Merrill

items.text: Merrill trains people new to wealth management through its Advisor Development Program, an entry-level path (Path A/B roles) for those without prior advisory experience who progress toward becoming a Merrill Financial Advisor.
items.quote: Candidates may hold the SIE prior to hire - Obtain the SIE, Series 7 and Series 66 with career expectation to become a Merrill Financial Advisor

items.text: Merrill's Advisor Development Program also advertises opportunities for existing (experienced) advisors with Series 7 and 66 licenses.
items.quote: Opportunities for existing advisors with Series 7 and 66

items.text: Merrill attracts talent across both new and experienced advisers.
items.quote: we continue to attract talent across both new and experienced advisers

items.text: Merrill adds financial advisors to its sales force through its extensive training program and experienced hiring of advisors.
items.quote: We also continued to add financial advisors to the sales force in Merrill and the Private Bank through our extensive training program and experienced hiring of advisors

items.text: Merrill attracts experienced advisers to the platform.
items.quote: our ability to attract clients and experienced advisers to the platform

items.text: Merrill has returned to veteran broker recruiting, after having largely pulled back from it at the end of 2017; it resumed under Co-Presidents Lindsay Hans and Eric Schimpf, who took over in 2023.
items.quote: Merrill executives in October touted that recruited assets to the wealth unit doubled year-over-year as the firm has returned to veteran broker recruiting. The firm largely pulled back from veteran broker recruiting at the end of 2017 but returned after Co-Presidents Lindsay Hans and Eric Schimpf, who took over in 2023, restored a focus on hiring and a more aggressive offer

items.text: Merrill recruited experienced advisor teams from rival wirehouses, adding several advisors from Morgan Stanley, Truist and Wells Fargo representing a combined $1.8 billion in client assets.
items.quote: Bank of America's Merrill Lynch has added several advisors from rivals, representing a combined $1.8 billion in client assets

items.text: Merrill recruited an experienced UBS team (John Vazquez and Manuel Monasterio) with four support staff and $1.2 billion in client assets in Santa Fe, N.M.
items.quote: Bank of America's Merrill Lynch wealth management team has added to a flurry of advisor recruiting wins this week by adding John Vazquez and Manuel Monasterio in Santa Fe, N.M., along with $1.2 billion in client assets

items.text: Merrill recruited an experienced private wealth team from UBS (Richard J. Cantwell and Alexander 'Ross' Kennedy) managing $1 billion in assets, joining its Northeast private wealth unit.
items.quote: A private wealth team managing $1 billion in assets at UBS Wealth Management USA jumped to Merrill Lynch in Boston
